How to use Warranty & Claims

Where a dealer's claim is checked and settled, and where warranty exposure is watched. Each claim carries the pump's heat number and winding batch, which is what makes it possible to spot a bad batch instead of arguing about one pump.

Do this, in order

  1. A dealer submits a claim; it lands in Pending Claims.
  2. Service Manager reviews it into Under Investigation. Quality Engineer approves or rejects on the evidence - photos, technician report, root cause.
  3. Approved claims go to Accounts to Settle, optionally against a credit note.
  4. Check Batch Defect Analysis whenever two claims share a heat or winding batch.

Watch out for

  • Rejecting without a root cause loses the only information the factory would get.
  • Warranty Expiring (30d) is a sales list, not a problem list - it is the AMC and replacement opportunity.
